The '''Shatter Crate''' is a special time-limited crate released in January 2015. It is structured similarly to the Impact Crate, with one five-star unit (x1), three four-star units (x2), and six three-star units (x4).

Cost: 120 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Badger]] x1 (unique to this crate)
* [[Wraith]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[The Ridge]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Scorcher]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Comet]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Coyote]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Drake]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Centro]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Estola]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Shrew]] x4 (unique to this crate)
